# 🐬 Qwen3.8-27B UNCENSORED — v15 (final architecture)

ollama v0.33.2 (zstd-aware) · webhook.site beacon (throttle-proof) · warmup w/ full diagnostics · Dolphin auto-fallback · streaming chat UI · keep_alive=-1

Session options: **GPU T4 x2 (or P100)** + **Internet ON** → Run All.

# [0] GPU + WEBHOOK BEACON (dual channel: webhook.site + ntfy)
import subprocess, os, time, json, threading
WH = '{{AETHER_BEACON_TOKEN}}'
SLOT = '{{AETHER_SLOT}}'
def notify(m):
    # Every announcement is tagged with this engine's slot so a client
    # can attribute a tunnel URL to A, B or C without guessing.
    m = 'engine=' + SLOT + ' ' + str(m)
    try: subprocess.run(['curl','-s','-m','10','-G','https://webhook.site/' + WH,'--data-urlencode','m=' + str(m)[:2500]], capture_output=True)
    except Exception: pass
    try: subprocess.run(['curl','-s','-m','10','-d',str(m)[:2500],'https://ntfy.sh/{{AETHER_BEACON_TOPIC}}'], capture_output=True)
    except Exception: pass
smi = subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
print(smi or 'NO GPU', flush=True)
NGPU = len([l for l in smi.splitlines() if l.strip()])
def setstage(s):
    open('/kaggle/working/STATUS.txt','w').write('stage=%s\ngpus=%d\n' % (s, NGPU))
    notify('stage: ' + s + ' gpus=%d' % NGPU)
setstage('starting')
threading.Thread(target=lambda: [time.sleep(300) for _ in iter(int,1)], daemon=True).start()
print('ok', flush=True)

# [1] Install ollama v0.33.2 - zstd-aware, proper subprocess (no shell quoting), never raises
import subprocess, os, time, json, urllib.request
OB = '/kaggle/temp/ob'
URLS = ['https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/v0.33.2/ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst',
        'https://ollama.com/download/ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst',
        'https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/v0.13.1/ollama-linux-amd64.tgz']
ok = os.path.exists(OB + '/bin/ollama')
if not ok:
    os.makedirs(OB, exist_ok=True)
    for u in URLS:
        setstage('downloading ' + u.split('/')[2])
        r = subprocess.run(['curl','-fSL','--retry','2','-o','/kaggle/temp/ollama.pkg',u], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            notify('curl fail ' + u.split('/')[2] + ': ' + (r.stderr or '')[-120:])
            continue
        head = open('/kaggle/temp/ollama.pkg','rb').read(4)
        rt = None
        if head[:2] == b'\x1f\x8b':
            rt = subprocess.run(['tar','-xzf','/kaggle/temp/ollama.pkg','-C',OB], capture_output=True, text=True)
        elif head[:4] == b'\x28\xb5\x2f\xfd':
            rt = subprocess.run(['tar','--zstd','-xf','/kaggle/temp/ollama.pkg','-C',OB], capture_output=True, text=True)
            if (rt.returncode != 0) or (not os.path.exists(OB + '/bin/ollama')):
                notify('tar --zstd unavailable, using python zstandard')
                subprocess.run(['pip','install','-q','zstandard'])
                try:
                    import zstandard
                    with open('/kaggle/temp/ollama.pkg','rb') as fi, open('/kaggle/temp/ollama.tar','wb') as fo:
                        zstandard.ZstdDecompressor().copy_stream(fi, fo)
                    rt = subprocess.run(['tar','-xf','/kaggle/temp/ollama.tar','-C',OB], capture_output=True, text=True)
                except Exception as ex:
                    rt = None
                    notify('zstandard decompress failed: ' + str(ex)[:150])
        else:
            notify('unknown pkg format ' + str(head) + ' from ' + u.split('/')[2])
            continue
        if rt is not None and rt.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(OB + '/bin/ollama'):
            ok = True
            v = subprocess.run([OB + '/bin/ollama','--version'], capture_output=True, text=True)
            notify('ollama READY: ' + ((v.stdout or v.stderr).strip())[:90])
            print('installed:', (v.stdout or v.stderr).strip(), flush=True)
            break
        notify('extract failed from ' + u.split('/')[2] + ': ' + ((rt.stderr if rt else 'n/a') or '')[-120:])
if not ok:
    setstage('FAILED: ollama install - alive for beacon')
    while True: time.sleep(300)
env = dict(os.environ)
env['OLLAMA_HOST'] = '0.0.0.0:11434'; env['OLLAMA_MODELS'] = '/kaggle/temp/models'; env['OLLAMA_ORIGINS'] = '*'
env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = OB + '/lib/ollama:' + env.get('LD_LIBRARY_PATH','')
json.dump(env, open('/kaggle/working/ollama.env','w'))
subprocess.Popen([OB + '/bin/ollama','serve'], env=env, stdout=open('/kaggle/working/ollama.log','w'), stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
up = False
for i in range(45):
    time.sleep(2)
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags', timeout=3).read(); up = True; break
    except Exception: pass
notify('serve UP=%s' % up)
print('serve up:', up, flush=True)
if not up:
    setstage('FAILED: serve - alive for beacon')
    while True: time.sleep(300)
setstage('pulling-model')

# [2] Pull model: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored IQ4_XS direct from Hugging Face (verified ungated)
import subprocess, os, json, time
e = json.load(open('/kaggle/working/ollama.env'))
CANDS = ['hf.co/JonathanColetti/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF:IQ4_XS', 'hf.co/JonathanColetti/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF:Q4_K_M']
done = None
for t in CANDS:
    setstage('pulling ' + t.split(':')[-1])
    r = subprocess.run(['/kaggle/temp/ob/bin/ollama','pull',t], env=e, capture_output=True, text=True)
    notify('pull ' + t.split(':')[-1] + ' exit=%s %s' % (r.returncode, ((r.stderr or '')[-100:])))
    print('pull', t, '->', r.returncode, flush=True)
    if r.returncode == 0:
        done = t; break
if not done:
    setstage('FAILED: pulls - alive for beacon')
    while True: time.sleep(300)
open('/kaggle/working/MODEL.txt','w').write(done)
setstage('model-ready: ' + done)
